reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: Code reading is correct: new_for_block_publishing (L221-250) skips signature verification, KZG proof verification, and inclusion proof checks compared to full gossip verification (validate_data_column_sidecar_for_gossip). However, this is BY DESIGN per the trust model. The comment at L219 explicitly states 'the EL will have already verified the cell proofs' - this is an intentional trust assumption for the local Engine API. When these columns are published to the network (publish_column_sidecars), receiving peers perform FULL gossip verification including all skipped checks. A compromised EL can only harm the local node (reputation/slashing), not bypass network-wide validation. Per BUG_BOUNTY_SCOPE.json, Engine API is SEMI_TRUSTED and 'attacks requiring a compromised local EL may be considered conditional or lower severity'. The spec requirement (INV-004: 'imported columns MUST behave as if received via gossip') applies to RECEIVING peers, not the local publishing node. Network validation is intact.
reviewed_items.spec_reference: Fulu p2p-interface SG-010 INV-004 requires imported columns to behave as gossip-received. This applies to receiving peers who DO perform full verification, not the local node's trust assumption for its own EL.
